author: Ari Koslow
title: Pavin Smith outrighted by Diamondbacks
desc: Pavin Smith cleared waivers and was outrighted to Triple-A Reno.
impact: Smith will remain in the Diamondbacks organization.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Keegan Akin undergoes elbow reconstruction surgery
desc: Orioles left-hander Keegan Akin has undergone left elbow reconstruction surgery.
impact: Akin recently underwent an MRI that revealed an injury to his left ulnar collateral ligament, and he underwent surgery performed by Dr. Keith Meister on Wednesday. The southpaw will miss the remainder of the season and most of the 2027 campaign, as well.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Paul Skenes to start Sunday for Pirates
desc: Paul Skenes will start on Sunday against the Guardians.
impact: Skenes will close out the first series out of the All-Star break for the Pirates. He posted a 3.57 ERA in the first half. He'll look to be even better the rest of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Braxton Ashcraft to start Saturday for Pirates
desc: Braxton Ashcraft will start on Saturday against the Guardians.
impact: Ashcraft delivered a very strong first half of the season for the Pirates. He'll look to carry it over into the rest of the year.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jadyn Fielder traded to Astros
desc: The Brewers have traded prospect Jadyn Fielder to the Astros in exchange for right-hander Lance McCullers Jr, left-hander Colton Gordon, and cash.
impact: Fielder, the 21-year-old son of former big leaguer Prince Fielder, was signed by the Brewers as an undrafted free agent in 2024. He has hit .233 with three homers, 10 stolen bases, and an .813 OPS across 45 games at the High-A level this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Jones to start Friday for Pirates
desc: Jared Jones will start on Friday against the Guardians.
impact: Jones will take the mound first for the Pirates out of the All-Star break. He has struggled on the season, but he's coming off tossing six scoreless innings against the Braves.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Robbie Ray to start Sunday for Giants
desc: Robbie Ray will start on Sunday against the Mariners.
impact: Ray will close out the first series out of the All-Star break for the Giants. He delivered a strong 3.38 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Webb to start Saturday for Giants
desc: Logan Webb will start on Saturday for the Giants against the Mariners.
impact: Webb elected not to pitch in the All-Star game on Tuesday. He posted a 3.86 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Grant Holmes to start Sunday versus Rangers
desc: Braves right-hander Grant Holmes will start Sunday's game against the Rangers.
impact: The Braves will send ace Chris Sale to open the second half on Friday, followed by rookie Owen Murphy on Saturday, and Holmes for the series finale on Sunday. The 30-year-old has posted a 3.61 ERA across 17 starts and one relief outing this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Landen Roupp to start Friday for Giants
desc: Landen Roupp will start for the Giants on Friday against the Mariners.
impact: Roupp struggled during the month of June, but delivered eight innings of one-run ball during his lone start in July. He'll look to carry that success into the rest of the season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Owen Murphy to start Saturday versus Rangers
desc: Braves right-hander Owen Murphy will start on Saturday against the Rangers.
impact: Murphy, 22, will make his first career MLB start on Saturday after appearing in two games in relief for the Rangers just prior to the All-Star break. Murphy has posted a 4.44 ERA in 16 starts this season for Triple-A Gwinnett.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Chris Sale to start Friday versus Rangers
desc: Braves left-hander Chris Sale will start on Friday versus the Rangers.
impact: The Braves' ace will get the ball to open the second half on Friday at home against the Rangers. The 2026 All-Star posted a dominant first half, working to a 2.20 ERA across 17 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sean Burke to start Sunday for White Sox
desc: Sean Burke will start on Sunday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Burke will close out the first series out of the break for the White Sox. He allowed just two runs over 13 innings across two starts so far in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Davis Martin to start Saturday for White Sox
desc: Davis Martin will take the mound for the White Sox on Saturday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Martin will take the mound second out of the All-Star break. He posted a strong 3.41 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Anthony Kay to start Friday for White Sox
desc: Anthony Kay will start on Friday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Kay will take the mound first for the White Sox out of the All-Star break. He has posted a 2.89 ERA across two starts so far in July.
